results.cause: Sub-threshold frontier fragments (< min_frontier_size) in cluttered start cause choose_frontiers to return empty, triggering immediate exploration_complete on first tick.
choose_frontiers rejects cost >= 99 with ValueError, causing explorer to immediately terminate with exploration_error without diagnostic reason or re-evaluation.
Nav2 succeeds within xy_goal_tolerance (0.25m) without moving. Baseline on_result blacklists target without verifying robot displacement, risking premature exploration completion.
Baseline explorer permanently adds aborted targets to self.excluded, permanently preventing retries even when transient obstacles clear.
validate_radii properly enforces the physical clearance floor, preventing dangerous margin reduction through impassable gaps.
Baseline increments mismatch_count on every loop iteration even when AMCL pose/scan timestamps have not changed, leading to premature false-mode reinitialization.
